annotations.text:
Colours only — layout, geometry and radii unchanged from the shipped shell and login card.
LIGHT theme only; the dark token block and the login's tb-dark block are not touched.
Navy chrome per --leftbar/--topheader; content sheet stays light.
Gradient --hoverbackground: active nav row only (and optionally the login CTA, option C).

Login: three states — default, invalid credentials, and a gradient-CTA option.
Pick A (flat #2067ff button) or C (gradient button) for the Sign in CTA.
